claims.text: Gild Hall is in Lower Manhattan's Financial District, steps from Wall Street, One World Trade Center and the Seaport.

findings.quote: Steps from Wall Street, One World Trade Center and the Seaport, Gild Hall, a Thompson Hotel is an elegant New York City retreat in the bustling Financial District, known as the FiDi.

claims.text: The hotel is a short walk from the National September 11 Memorial & Museum, Pier 17 and Battery Park.

findings.quote: Gild Hall resides just a short walk from some of New York City's most incredible sites
visit the National September 11 Memorial & Museum, swing by Pier 17 or walk along Battery Park

claims.text: Rooms and suites have marble-floored bathrooms.

findings.quote: Our boutique hotel’s rooms and suites feature tufted leather headboards, 400-thread-count linens, and marble-floored bathrooms

claims.text: The 1 King Bed Premium room has 12-foot ceilings and a custom leather headboard with buckle detailing.

findings.quote: With more space to spread out, this warm midcentury-style room features one king bed, 12-foot ceilings, and a custom leather headboard with buckle detailing.

claims.text: The Thompson Suite has a separate lounge area, 12-foot ceilings, a bar and a bathroom with a clawfoot tub.

findings.quote: separate lounge area for mingling, 12-foot ceilings, and a bar for mixing up a delicious cocktail. The luxe bathroom with clawfoot tub makes unwinding easy.

claims.text: Felice Ristorante serves Italian classics inspired by rustic Tuscan fare and is available for large groups and private events.

findings.quote: to enjoy Italian classics inspired by rustic Tuscan fare. The restaurant is also available for large groups and private events.

claims.text: La Soffitta is the hotel's upstairs wine bar.

findings.quote: Head upstairs to the 35-seat La Soffitta wine bar

claims.text: Gild Hall is pet friendly and welcomes dogs.

findings.quote: Gild Hall is a pet-friendly hotel and welcomes your dog on your next stay in New York’s Financial District.

claims.text: The hotel's destination fee includes two welcome glasses of Prosecco per registered guest on arrival and use of vintage-inspired bicycles.

findings.quote: Two Welcome Glasses of Prosecco (per registered guest) upon arrival
Use of vintage-inspired bicycles

claims.text: The nearest subway station is Fulton Street, served by the 2, 3, 4, 5, A, C, J and Z trains.

findings.quote: The nearest subway station to Gild Hall, A Thompson Hotel is the Fulton Street station. This station is served by the 2, 3, 4, 5, A, C, J, and Z trains.

claims.text: The interiors showcase the design aesthetic of midcentury modern expert Jim Walrod and the photography of Slim Aarons.

findings.quote: showcases the design aesthetic of mid-century modern expert Jim Walrod and the photography of the iconic Slim Aarons

claims.text: La Soffitta wine bar holds a collection of more than 100 Italian wines in custom shelves.

findings.quote: An expertly curated collection of more than 100 Italian wines encased in custom shelves gives the bar its nightly glow

claims.text: The Penthouse Suite, the hotel's largest, has a dining area for up to eight.

findings.quote: Enjoy a stay in the hotel’s largest suite, the Penthouse Suite, featuring Jim Walrod-designed midcentury interiors in the living area, a dining area for up to eight

claims.text: Rooms and suites have custom leather headboards designed by Jim Walrod and 400-thread-count Sferra linens.

findings.quote: feature custom leather headboards designed by Jim Walrod and 400-thread count Sferra linens

claims.text: The hotel offers Peloton bikes, Peloton rowers and free weights, plus complimentary bikes for exploring the Financial District.

findings.quote: Our Lower Manhattan hotel offers Peloton bikes and Peloton rowers as well as free weights; or take a spin outside on a complimentary bike and explore the Financial District.

claims.text: A daily destination fee is charged per room.

findings.quote: A daily destination fee of $35.00 (subject to change)
is applied to each room of your stay

claims.text: Valet parking has no in-and-out privileges, and the garage cannot take large vehicles or pickup trucks.

findings.quote: This does not include in-and-out privileges and the garage and cannot accommodate large vehicles or pickup trucks.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the business-focused location may be quieter on weekends.
